data.description: DIP is renowned for its strategic location, modern infrastructure, and vibrant community.

data.answer:
DIP also boasts a robust commercial and industrial sector, making it a hub for businesses and industries. The development includes warehouses, office spaces, and manufacturing units, attracting a diverse range of companies.

The strategic location, state-of-the-art facilities, and a business-friendly environment make Dubai Investments Park a preferred choice for enterprises looking to establish a presence in the region. Integrating residential, commercial, and industrial components within a single development underscores DIP's significance as a comprehensive and self-sufficient community.

Dubai Investments Park (DIP) comprises several subcommunities, including Green Community, Ewan Residences, and Ritaj. Each subcommunity offers a range of residential and commercial properties, providing diverse living and business options within the development.

Dubai Investments Park (DIP) offers a variety of residential options including villas, townhouses, apartments, and staff quarters. Featuring high-quality construction and modern design, the development is meticulously planned to provide maximum convenience for both residents and commercial property owners. The residential area in DIP is organized into clusters, each offering a diverse range of homes in different sizes and designs.

One notable sub-community is Green Community, developed by Properties Investment. Surrounded by green spaces, this area provides a serene and stress-free environment. It offers a variety of residential units nestled among parks and greenery, making it an ideal family-friendly community. In addition to built-in amenities, this self-contained community features a supermarket and a small shopping center.

On the commercial side, DIP includes projects such as Schon Business Park and Bayan Business Centre, offering a range of offices and shops. DIP is also one of the top areas in Dubai for renting warehouses, with options ranging from 60 sq. ft. units costing around AED 7k to expansive 300,000 sq. ft. warehouses for AED 8.4M. Commercial complexes in DIP feature offices for rent in a price range of AED 30k to AED 388k, depending on size and facilities, while shops average around AED 156k per year.

Off Plan Projects in Dubai Investments Park

Various properties are under development in the area, including Verdana 3 and Olivia Residences. Verdana 3 is the new phase of a townhouse project in the area called Verdana. It features 2—to 5-bedroom townhouses, with a limited number of apartments available in studio to 2-bedroom configurations.

The other project, Olivia Residences, is an apartment complex offering one, two, and three-bedroom units with breathtaking views of the Green Community Park.

Buying a Property in Dubai Investments Park

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai Investment Park? Apartments for sale in Dubai Investment Park come in various configurations, with studio flats averaging AED 299k and 1-bedroom apartments in Dubai Investment Park around AED 489k. Potential investors might consider properties in Centurion Residences, Dunes Village, or Ritaj. Families seeking larger apartments can find 3-bedroom flats for around AED 1.2M, spanning 2,600 to 3,000 sq. ft. More affordable 2-bedroom flats average AED 743k.

In the Green Community, there is a wide variety of villas available. 4-bedroom villas have an average price of AED 4.5M, while family-sized 5-bedroom villas are valued at approximately AED 3.5M.

Rental Properties in Dubai Investments Park

Seeking properties for rent in Dubai? The residential sector in DIP includes a wide range of apartments suitable for singles and large families, with studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom flats available. Studio flats start at AED 25k annually, while 1-bedroom apartments range from AED 29k to AED 42k, depending on size and construction date. Larger 2-bedroom apartments are available for around AED 52k, and 3-bedroom flats average AED 79k per year. Spacious 3 and 4-bedroom villas in Dubai Investment Park can be rented for AED 145k and AED 155k per year, respectively, though independent units are currently limited.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Investments Park?

data.answer:
Life in Dubai Investment Park (DIP) is a blend of convenience, comfort, and community. With its mix of residential, commercial, and industrial zones, DIP offers a unique lifestyle catering to families, professionals, and businesses alike. Residents enjoy a tranquil environment with lush green spaces, parks, and recreational facilities, all designed to promote a balanced lifestyle. The area is also home to top-notch schools, healthcare facilities, and entertainment options, ensuring that everything you need is within reach. DIP's strategic location provides easy access to key areas of Dubai, enhancing its appeal as a desirable place to live and work.

Public Transportation in Dubai Investments Park

Public transportation in Dubai Investment Park is well-developed, providing residents and workers with several convenient options. The area is served by multiple bus routes that connect to major hubs like the Dubai Metro and other parts of the city.

Moreover, DIP is close to the Dubai Metro's Red Line, with the Dubai Investment Park metro station being Ibn Battuta, approximately a 15-minute drive away. This connectivity ensures that commuting to and from DIP is hassle-free, making it an attractive location for those who rely on public transport.
Supermarkets in and Near Dubai Investments Park

Residents of Dubai Investment Park have easy access to a variety of supermarkets, ensuring their daily needs are met with convenience. Within DIP, there are several well-stocked supermarkets such as Choithrams and Carrefour, providing a range of groceries and household items. For additional options, residents can drive to nearby areas like The Gardens and Jebel Ali Village, where more supermarkets such as Spinneys and Geant are located, all within a 10-15 minute drive. This makes grocery shopping in and around DIP both easy and convenient.

Shopping Malls in and Near Dubai Investments Park Area

Dubai Investment Park is strategically located near several shopping malls, offering residents a plethora of retail and entertainment options. The closest mall is the Ibn Battuta Mall, just a 15-minute drive away, featuring a wide range of shops, dining options, and a cinema. Another nearby option is The Mall of the Emirates, which is approximately a 25-minute drive from DIP and offers an extensive selection of international brands, dining experiences, and entertainment venues, including Ski Dubai. These malls provide residents with ample opportunities for shopping, dining, and leisure activities.

Schools in Dubai Investments Park

Dubai Investments Park (DIP) offers a range of educational facilities catering to families with children of all ages. The area is home to several well-regarded schools, including the Greenfield Community School, which follows the IB curriculum, and the British Columbia Canadian School, offering the British Columbia curriculum. There are also numerous nurseries such as Chubby Cheeks Nursery and The Children's Garden, providing quality early childhood education. These institutions are conveniently located within DIP, ensuring that residents have access to excellent educational options close to home.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Dubai Investments Park

Residents of Dubai Investments Park have access to various places of worship, accommodating a diverse range of faiths. Within DIP, there are several mosques, including the Al Shafa Mosque and the DIP Mosque, providing easy access to daily prayers. For other faiths, the nearby Jebel Ali area, approximately a 15-minute drive from DIP, houses a variety of religious centers such as the St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, the Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara, and the Hindu Temple. This ensures that all residents can practice their faith conveniently.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Investments Park Area

Dubai Investment Park is well-served by a range of healthcare facilities, ensuring residents have access to quality medical care. Within DIP, there are several clinics, such as NMC Royal Medical Centre and Care One Polyclinic, that offer a variety of medical services. For more comprehensive care, residents can visit nearby hospitals like NMC Royal Hospital in DIP, which is a short drive away, and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, approximately 20 minutes away. These facilities provide a full spectrum of healthcare services, from general practice to specialized treatments.

Dubai Investments Park Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Investments Park spans over 2,300 hectares and is strategically situated near key highways, offering easy access to major areas like Jumeirah Golf Estates, Dubai Marina, Jebel Ali, and Downtown Dubai. Its prime location provides excellent connectivity via major roads such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Emirates Road, making it convenient for residents and businesses alike to reach other parts of Dubai. This strategic positioning enhances the appeal of DIP as a desirable place for both living and working, with major commercial and recreational hubs just a short drive away.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Investments Park

data.answer:
Dubai Investments Park (DIP) offers a variety of recreational activities and leisure facilities for residents and visitors. There are several parks and green spaces ideal for jogging, picnics, and outdoor sports. The Green Community provides picturesque walking and cycling paths, along with lakes and playgrounds for family outings. DIP also houses fitness centers and gyms, catering to various workout preferences. For those who enjoy golf, the nearby Jebel Ali Golf Resort offers a challenging course and luxurious amenities.

Restaurants in Dubai Investments Park Free Zone

Dubai Investments Park Free Zone boasts a diverse selection of dining options, catering to different tastes and preferences. Residents and visitors can enjoy international cuisines at restaurants like The Market Restaurant and Café, serving a variety of dishes in a casual setting. For those looking for quick bites, there are numerous fast-food outlets and cafes. Additionally, the area hosts several fine dining establishments and themed restaurants, providing gourmet experiences for special occasions.

Beaches Near Dubai Investments Park

While Dubai Investments Park is inland, residents have easy access to several beautiful beaches just a short drive away. Jebel Ali Beach is one of the nearest options, located about 20 minutes away, offering a tranquil environment for relaxation and water activities. Another popular beach is the iconic Jumeirah Beach, approximately a 25-minute drive, where visitors can enjoy stunning views of the Burj Al Arab, water sports, and a lively beachfront atmosphere. These beaches provide the perfect escape for a day of sun, sand, and sea.

Dubai Investments Park Hotels

Dubai Investments Park offers a range of accommodation options, including several well-appointed hotels. Premier Inn Dubai Investments Park is a popular choice, providing comfortable rooms and modern amenities at reasonable rates. Another notable option is the Marriott Executive Apartments Dubai Green Community, offering spacious serviced apartments ideal for extended stays. These hotels cater to both business travelers and tourists, ensuring a pleasant and convenient stay with easy access to the rest of Dubai. There are also varotels near Dubai Investment Park, like Maian Hotel.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Investments Park

Dubai Investments Park is strategically located near several notable attractions and landmarks. Expo 2020 is just a short drive away, offering visitors a chance to explore its impressive pavilions and exhibits. Another nearby attraction is the Ibn Battuta Mall, themed around the travels of the famous explorer, featuring diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For those interested in nature and wildlife, the Dubai Butterfly Garden and Dubai Miracle Garden are also within a 30-minute drive, providing unique and beautiful experiences.

One minor drawback of living in Dubai Investments Park (DIP) is that it can experience traffic congestion during peak hours due to its proximity to major industrial and commercial zones. This can lead to longer commute times for residents, especially during rush hours.

What types of properties are available in Dubai Investments Park (DIP)?

Dubai Investments Park offers a variety of property types, including residential apartments, villas, townhouses, commercial offices, retail spaces, and industrial warehouses.

What amenities and facilities are available in Dubai Investments Park (DIP)?

DIP features numerous amenities such as schools, hospitals, shopping centers, parks, fitness centers, restaurants, and recreational facilities, ensuring a convenient and comfortable lifestyle for residents and businesses.

How well-connected is Dubai Investments Park (DIP) to other parts of Dubai?

DIP is strategically located near key highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Emirates Road, providing easy access to major areas in Dubai. It is also close to the Jebel Ali Free Zone and Al Maktoum International Airport.

Is Dubai Investments Park (DIP) a good place for businesses?

Yes, DIP is a prime location for businesses due to its modern infrastructure, well-planned industrial zones, commercial spaces, and proximity to major transportation hubs, making it ideal for various industries.

What are the educational options available in Dubai Investments Park (DIP)?

DIP is home to several reputable schools and nurseries offering various curriculums, including international, British, and American, providing quality education options for families residing in the area.

nodes.title: Olivia Residences
nodes.about:

The residence includes a wide range of amenities: landscape pool, yoga and meditation area, zen garden, gym with panoramic views, sauna, Jacuzzi, outdoor movie theater, children's playground with water elements, babysitting services for children in the outdoor area, 24-hour security. Olivia Residences consists of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments.

DIP 1 is an attractive investment location due to its strategic location close to key transportation routes, benefiting logistics and retail businesses. It provides an integrated community with all the necessary amenities, making it attractive to residents and businesses, and has a growing number of residential developments for a dynamic lifestyle in Dubai.

The nearest points from the residence when traveling by car are DIP Metro 3 minutes, Mall of Emirates 15 minutes, Global Village 15 minutes, Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall 20 minutes and DXB Airport 25 minutes.

The developer of Olivia Residences is Karma Developers Group, a luxury lifestyle developer.
